title: Poverty and the Poor
lead: The law gives the poor rights, not only charity: debts are released, slaves go free with gifts, wages are paid daily, pledges are returned, and harvest leftovers belong to the needy (Deuteronomy 15; 24). The prophets measure Israel's faithfulness by how it treats the poor, and Jesus begins his preaching with "good news to the poor" (Luke 4:18).
